Requirement.rationale: Allows for some optimization of memory usage if buffers of varying sizes are needed

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall allocate the first buffer larger than the requested size from the set of unallocated buffers, starting with the smallest set of buffers.
Requirement.rationale: If a buffer from a smaller pool is not available, allow using larger buffers to avoid starving the user

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall return an empty buffer (size = 0) if no buffers are available
Requirement.rationale: Allow the user to decide how to react to no memory

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall accept empty returned buffers without an assert
Requirement.rationale: Just send a warning to cover the case where an empty buffer is returned by a component

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall use a provided Fw::MemAllocator instance to request overall buffer memory
Requirement.rationale: Let the user decide where the memory comes from

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall allow buffers to be returned in any order
Requirement.rationale: Do not restrict the lifetime or usage of buffers

`Svc::ComQueue` shall queue `Fw::Buffer` and `Fw::ComBuffer` received on incoming ports.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of the queue is to store messages.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall output exactly one `Fw::Buffer` (wrapping the queued data units) on a received `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` obeys the communication adapter interface protocol.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall pause sending on the  `Fw::Success::FAILURE` and restart on the next `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should not sent to a failing communication adapter.

Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should be adaptable for a number of projects.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall implement a round robin approach to balance between ports of the same priority.

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall read a set of directories and build a catalog of data products.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` needs to know at least one directory where data products reside

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products first based on the internally recorded priority where the highest priority is represented by the lowest number.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` needs to downlink highest priority items first

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products second based on the internally recorded time with oldest products as higher priority.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` needs to downlink oldest items first

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products third based on the internally recorded product ID with the lowest as higher priority.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` needs to resolve case where priority and time match

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall update the data product metadata once download is complete
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` needs to track completion status to avoid duplicate downloads

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a command and port to build the catalog.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` should consume the resources to build the catalog only when needed

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a command and port to start downloading the catalog.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` downloads should be timed for when communications are ready, and not consume comm window time building

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall have filters for the download based on container ID, priority, and data size limit.
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` downloads should be tunable for available bandwidth and container metadata

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a way to insert newly-generated data products into the catalog after the catalog is built
Requirement.rationale: `DpCatalog` should notice new products and not require a rebuild of the catalog

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement commands to modify the priority of existing data products
Requirement.rationale: Operators made change the priority to lower or raise priorities due to troubleshooting, etc

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement commands to delete data products
Requirement.rationale: Ground tools can use DpManager commands to automatically delete DPs

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a catalog data product that is a listing of existing data products and their metadata
Requirement.rationale: Allow operators to know what products exist

Requirement.text: `DpCatalog` shall have filters for the catalog data product for priority, container ID, and time range
Requirement.rationale: Allow operators to know what products exist

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide an array of ports for synchronously requesting and receiving data product buffers.
Requirement.rationale: This capability supports the `product` `get` port in the auto-generated code for components that define data products.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide arrays of ports for receiving and asynchronously responding to requests for data product buffers.
Requirement.rationale: This capability supports the `product` `request` and `product` `recv` ports in the auto-generated code for components that define data products.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall receive data product buffers and forward them for further processing.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement provides a pass-through capability for sending data product buffers to downstream components. `Svc::DpManager` receives data product input on a port of type  `Fw::DpSend`. This input consists of a container ID and an `Fw::Buffer` _B_. `Svc::DpManager` sends _B_ on a port of type `Fw::BufferSend`. This port type is used by the standard F Prime components for managing and logging data, e.g., `Svc::BufferAccumulator`, `Svc::DpWriter`.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide telemetry that reports the number of successful allocations, the number of failed allocations, and the volume of data handled.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement establishes the telemetry interface for the component.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide a port for receiving `Fw::Buffer` objects pointing to filled data product containers.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of `DpWriter` is to write the data products to disk.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide an array of ports for sending `Fw::Buffer` objects for processing.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement supports downstream processing of the data in the buffer.

Requirement.text: On receiving a data product container _C_, `Svc::DpWriter` shall use the processing type field of the header of _C_ to select zero or more processing ports to invoke, in port order.
Requirement.rationale: The processing type field is a bit mask. A one in bit `2^n` in the bit mask selects port index `n`.

Requirement.text: On receiving an `Fw::Buffer` _B_, and after performing any requested processing on _B_, `Svc::DpWriter` shall write _B_ to disk.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of `DpWriter` is to write data products to the disk.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide a port for notifying other components that data products have been written.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement allows `Svc::DpCatalog` or a similar component to update its catalog in real time.

Requirement.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide telemetry that reports the number of buffers received, the number of data products written, the number of bytes written, the number of failed writes, and the number of errors.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement establishes the telemetry interface for the component.
